description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Applied Intuition is hiring a software engineer to develop products, features, and tools for customers’ autonomy development workflows. The role involves working across the software stack, collaborating with users and experts in infrastructure, robotics, and graphics, and contributing to technical and product decisions.
Software Engineer developing autonomy workflow products, features, and sensor simulation tools across the stack

Responsibilities:
• Work across our entire stack to develop new products, features, and tools for our customers' autonomy development workflows
• Have an unparalleled opportunity to work with domain experts across a variety of fields: infrastructure, robotics, and graphics engineers, as well as startup veterans
• Carve out your own area of expertise and influence product decisions
• Collaborate with other members in the autonomy ecosystem and learn about different approaches to solving core issues in autonomy

Requirements:
• BS/MS degree (completed or in progress) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
• Basic understanding of UX Fundamentals and design principles
• Proven ability as a self-starter and can quickly become comfortable with new technical tools
• Designed efficient and effective solutions to a wide range of engineering challenges
• Desire to take initiative in a fast-paced environment
• Proficiency in at least one scripting language such as C / C++, Python, JavaScript, Java, etc
• Strong analytical thinking, obsessive attention to detail, and excellent verbal/written communication

Preferred:
• Experience working with simulation tools, modeling physical problems, using robotics middleware, designing user-facing applications or developing video games
• Experience working with designers and frontend engineers
